review.rationale: The supplied Gold is an appropriate independent planning expectation for the frozen bundle. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, the exact implementation/test binding scope, and the implementation plus dependent independent-verification tasks agree with the original PRD. Source evidence supports a request-local callback extension, not a required shared-data or state change; pending data.change and domain.state claims therefore do not invalidate the assignments. Both allowed agents have the relevant active project-scoped claims, and the verifier additionally has testing.verification. The configured independent reviewer satisfies the stated non-executing review prerequisite. The supplied inputs contain no unresolved material DEC-001 requiring a decisions-stage block. Type-check inclusion and the separate runtime-test entry are established by configuration, and build configuration establishes that published declarations are generated rather than separately maintained owners. Ready denotes planning readiness, not approval to execute or dispatch tasks. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree; the supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest and evaluation source-digest domains. I rely on the Service's mechanical binding of digests to saved inputs, without claiming independent digest recomputation, code execution, or human attestation. Retained old-version operations are historical only, and the supplied isolation facts establish that this Gold precedes every candidate on this bundle.
